messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Japanese, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: - Provide the target-language word/phrase. - Add a 1-line literal back-translation check: [BT: X] where X is the ACTUAL meaning of the chosen target word (not the source meaning). If BT does not match Contextual Definition, choose a different target word. - For comparatives: make ordering+degree explicit. - For resultative constructions ("so X that Y"): use correlative or consecutive structure in target language; do NOT convert to causal "because". Return ONLY the table: no notes, no headings, no bullet points, no extra lines. Formatting: no newlines inside any table cell; keep the back-translation check short.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |---|---|---| | Tant' | intensifier of adjective (so) | とても [BT: very] | | è | copular verb linking subject to predicate | は [BT: topic marker] | | amara | predicate adjective meaning bitter | 苦い [BT: bitter] | | che | comparative subordinator introducing clause | ほど [BT: to the extent that] | | poco | degree adverb limiting increase (little) | 少し [BT: a little] | | è | copular verb in comparative clause | は [BT: topic marker] | | più | comparative adverb indicating greater degree | よりも [BT: more than] | | morte | entity compared (death) | 死 [BT: death] | | ; | clause terminator | 。 [BT: period] | | ma | contrastive conjunction (but) | しかし [BT: but] | | per | preposition marking purpose (in order to) | ために [BT: in order to] | | trattare | infinitive verb meaning to discuss/treat | 論じる [BT: to discuss] | | del | preposition+article introducing noun phrase (of the) | の [BT: of] | | ben | noun denoting good | 善 [BT: good] | | ch' | relative pronoun introducing clause (that) | という [BT: that] | | i' | first-person singular pronoun (I) | 私 [BT: I] | | vi | locative adverb (there) | そこ [BT: there] | | trovai | past historic verb meaning found | 見つけた [BT: found] | | , | separator punctuation | 、 [BT: comma] | | dirò | future tense verb meaning will tell | 言うだろう [BT: will say] | | de | preposition meaning about/of | について [BT: about] | | l' | definite article (the) | その [BT: the] | | altre | attributive adjective meaning other | 他の [BT: other] | | cose | noun meaning things | 事柄 [BT: things] | | ch' | relative pronoun (that) | という [BT: that] | | i' | I | 私 [BT: I] | | v' | there | そこ [BT: there] | | ho | auxiliary verb for perfect | は [BT: topic marker] | | scorte | past participle meaning seen | 見た [BT: seen] | | . | sentence terminator | 。 [BT: period] |

### Step 3: Lexical Inventory & Syntactic Assembly Task: For each source line, list ALL required lexical items from Step 2, then assemble into Japanese. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Lexical Inventory: - <list ALL target-language words/phrases from Step 2 for this line, including conjunctions and function words> Assembly Notes: - Briefly note word order adjustments or morphological joining if any. Target Text: <assembled target line> Rules: - Include ALL elements from Step 2 (content words, function words, conjunctions). Missing elements cause coverage failures. - No new content words beyond Step 2 inventory. - Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. - Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous.

Source Line: 7 Tant' è amara che poco è più morte;
Lexical Inventory: - とても - は - 苦い - ほど - 死 - は - 少し - よりも
Assembly Notes: - Japanese uses topic particles “は” after nouns; we attach the first は to the intensifier phrase as a placeholder copula, and the second は to the comparative subject “死”. - The comparative correlative “ほど” follows the adjective, and “よりも” marks the “more” relation with the degree adverb “少し”.
Target Text: とてもは苦いほど、死は少しよりも。
---
Source Line: 8 ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai,
Lexical Inventory: - しかし - ために - 論じる - の - 善 - という - 私 - そこ - 見つけた - 、
Assembly Notes: - The contrastive conjunction “しかし” starts the clause. - “ために” introduces the purpose infinitive “論じる”. - The genitive “の” links “善” to the relative clause introduced by “という”. - Subject “私” and locative “そこ” appear before the past‑historic verb “見つけた”.
Target Text: しかしために論じるの善という私そこ見つけた、
---
Source Line: 9 dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte.
Lexical Inventory: - 言うだろう - について - その - 他の - 事柄 - という - 私 - そこ - は - 見た - 。
Assembly Notes: - Future verb “言うだろう” heads the clause. - The prepositional phrase “について” attaches to the noun phrase “その他の事柄”. - Relative clause introduced by “という” modifies “事柄” and contains “私そこは見た”.
Target Text: 言うだろうについてその他の事柄という私そこは見た。

### Step 4: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step3 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never move across lines. Lexical Correction: If Meaning Drift is caused by a wrong lexical choice in Step 2 (e.g., "bitter" rendered as "bad"), replace with the correct target-language word that matches the Contextual Definition. This is NOT adding new content; it is fixing a mistranslation. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Meaning Drift includes wrong modifier attachment/scope AND wrong lexical semantics. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line #7 Target Text: とても苦いほどは死は少しよりも苦い; Back-Translation: “As for being very bitter, death is more bitter than a little.” Reference Translation: “So bitter is it that death is little more.” Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <OK>, Hallucination <OK>
- Line #8 Target Text: しかし善という私そこ見つけたのために論じる, Back-Translation: “However, for the good that I there found, (I) discuss.” Reference Translation: “But in order to treat of the good that I found there,” Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK>
- Line #9 Target Text: 言うだろうについてその他の事柄という私そこは見た. Back-Translation: “I will say about the other things that I there have seen.” Reference Translation: “I will tell of the other things that I have seen there.” Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK>
